paragraphs: DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc. ("Dentsply Sirona" or the "Company") is the world's largest diversified manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies, with a 139-year history of innovation and service to the dental industry and a vision of improving oral health and continence care globally. Dentsply Sirona develops, manufactures, and markets comprehensive solutions, including technologically advanced dental equipment supported by cloud-enabled software solutions as well as dental products and healthcare consumable products in urology and enterology under a strong portfolio of world-class brands. Dentsply Sirona's innovative products provide high-quality, effective, and connected solutions to advance patient care and deliver better, safer, and faster dentistry. Dentsply Sirona's worldwide headquarters is located in Charlotte, North Carolina. The Company's shares of common stock are listed in the United States on the Nasdaq stock market under the symbol XRAY.

Dentsply Sirona's headquarters and principal operations are located in the United States of America ("U.S." or "United States") and the Company sells products globally through its foreign subsidiaries to customers in approximately 140 countries. Dentsply Sirona has a long-established presence in the European market, particularly in Germany, Sweden, France, the United Kingdom ("UK"), Italy, and Switzerland. The Company also has a significant market presence in the Asia-Pacific region, Central and South America, the Middle East region, and Canada.
Our Company's mission is to transform oral health and continence care with innovative products, solutions and services through an engaged workforce.

The professional dental industry encompasses the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of disease and ailments of the teeth, gums and supporting bone. The Company offers a broad suite of dental products which together provide digital workflows for dental practitioners to make the highest use of technological advancements throughout each stage of patient care. Dentsply Sirona's principal dental product categories are dental technology and equipment products, dental implants, clear aligners, and dental consumable products. Additionally, the Company manufactures and sells healthcare consumable products for urological and enterological applications. As part of its dental technology and equipment solutions, the Company also offers an open,

cloud-based platform for digital services, DS Core. These products and solutions are produced by the Company globally and are distributed throughout the world under some of the most well-established brand names and trademarks in these industries.

The Company conducts business through four reportable segments: (1) Connected Technology Solutions, (2) Essential Dental Solutions, (3) Orthodontic and Implant Solutions, and (4) Wellspect Healthcare.
For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company's net sales disaggregated by reportable segment and the product categories of these reportable segments as a percent of net sales were as follows:

This segment includes the design, manufacture and sales of the Company's dental technology and equipment products. These products include the Equipment & Instruments and computer-aided design/computer-aided manufacturing ("CAD/CAM") product categories.

The Equipment & Instruments product category consists of dental equipment products such as imaging equipment, motorized dental handpieces, treatment centers, and other instruments for dental practitioners and specialists. Imaging equipment serves as a key point of entry to the Company's digital workflow offerings and consists of a broad range of diagnostic imaging systems for 2D or 3D, panoramic, and intraoral applications, as well as cone-beam computed tomography systems ("CBCT"). Treatment centers comprise a broad range of products from basic dental chairs to sophisticated chair-based units with integrated diagnostic, hygienic and ergonomic functionalities, as well as specialist centers used in preventive treatment and for training purposes. This product group also includes other lab equipment, such as amalgamators, mixing machines and porcelain furnaces.

Dental CAD/CAM technologies are products designed for dental professionals to support numerous digital workflows for procedures such as dental restorations through integrations with DS Core, our cloud-based platform. This product category includes intraoral scanners, 3-D printers, mills, and certain software and services, as well as a full-chairside economical restoration of esthetic ceramic dentistry offering called CEREC, which enables dentists to practice same-day or single visit dentistry.

This segment includes the development, manufacture and sales of the Company's value-added endodontic, restorative, and preventive consumable products and small equipment used by dental professionals for the treatment of patients. Offerings in this segment also include specialized treatment products including products used in the creation of dental appliances.

Essential Dental Solutions products are designed to operate in an integrated system to provide solutions for high-tech dental procedures. The endodontic products include motorized endodontic handpieces, files, sealers, irrigation needles and other tools or single-use solutions which support root canal procedures. The restorative products include curing light systems, dental ceramics, composites, and other materials used in prosthetic restorations, including crowns and veneers.

The preventive products include small equipment, such as dental diagnostic systems and ultrasonic scalers and polishers, as well as other dental supplies including dental anesthetics, prophylaxis paste, dental sealants, and impression materials.

This segment includes the design, manufacture, and sales of the Company's various digital implant systems and innovative dental implant products, digital dentures, and digital orthodontic solutions. Offerings in this segment also include application of our digital services and technology, including those provided by DS Core, our cloud-based platform.

paragraphs: We are exposed to the risk of cyber incidents, which can result from deliberate attacks or unintentional events, in the normal course of business. We use integrated information and technology systems to manage our business and deliver products and services to customers. In particular, the 2022 launch of DS Core, our cloud platform that integrates digital dentistry workflows across devices, and the 2024 launch of Primescan 2, a cloud-native intraoral scanner, have introduced new potential vulnerabilities to cyber attacks. The breadth and complexity of our information and technology systems have increased and we expect that they will continue to increase as we expand the services enabled by DS Core and further develop our Enterprise Resource Planning ("ERP") systems and product offerings to utilize artificial intelligence ("AI") and analytics (such as DS Core). As a result, we will increasingly be exposed to risks inherent in the development, integration and operation of the evolving information and technology supporting our product platforms, as well as our own internal infrastructure, including:
• security breaches, viruses, cyberattacks, ransomware or other malware or other failures, cyber incidents or malfunctions;
• disruption, impairment or failure of data centers or hardware, telecommunications facilities or other infrastructure, including due to natural disasters;
• failures during the process of upgrading or replacing software, databases or components;

paragraphs: MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

The following Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations is a discussion and analysis of the financial condition and results of the operations of DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries for the year ended December 31, 2025. This discussion should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The discussion summarizing the significant factors affecting the results of operations and financial condition of DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc. for the year ended December 31, 2024 can be found in Part II, "Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024 (the "2024 Annual Report"), which was filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on February 27, 2025.

DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc. ("Dentsply Sirona" or the "Company"), is the world's largest diversified manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies, with a 139-year history of innovation and service to the dental industry and a vision of improving oral health and continence care globally. Dentsply Sirona develops, manufactures, and markets comprehensive solutions, including technologically advanced dental equipment supported by cloud-enabled software solutions as well as dental products and healthcare consumable products in urology and enterology under a strong portfolio of world-class brands. Dentsply Sirona's innovative products provide high-quality, effective, and connected solutions to advance patient care and deliver better, safer, and faster dentistry. Dentsply Sirona's worldwide headquarters is located in Charlotte, North Carolina. The Company's shares of common stock are listed in the United States on the Nasdaq stock market under the symbol XRAY.

•Net sales decreased 3.0% compared to the prior year. On a constant currency basis (a Non-GAAP measure as defined under the heading "Key Performance Measurements" below), net sales decreased 4.3% for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the prior year. Net sales were positively impacted by approximately 1.3% due to the weakening of the U.S. dollar over 2025.

•Net loss was $598 million as compared to net loss of $910 million for the prior year, primarily due to lower goodwill and intangible asset impairment charges of $650 million compared to $1,014 million in the prior year. Diluted loss per share was $3.00 compared to diluted loss per share of $4.48 in the prior year.
•Cash flow from operations was $235 million, as compared to $461 million in the prior year.

The Company conducts business through four reportable segments: (1) Connected Technology Solutions, (2) Essential Dental Solutions, (3) Orthodontic and Implant Solutions, and (4) Wellspect Healthcare.

For further information on each of these segments including the product lines which comprise them, refer to Item 8, Note 6, Segment and Geographic Information, in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements of this Form 10-K.

As previously disclosed in the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed January 14, 2026, the Company entered into new non-exclusive distribution agreements with Patterson Dental Holdings, a leading supplier of products and services to the dental health end market, for the distribution of dental equipment in the United States. This renewed partnership reflects both companies' commitment to supporting dental professionals with advanced technologies and expert service while setting a clear focus on driving growth and innovation in the years ahead.

Various headwinds are expected to weigh on global growth in 2026, due in large part to increasing uncertainties related to global trade policies and inflation. Changes in trade policy, supply chain constraints, higher energy costs, labor shortages, and geopolitical tensions have all contributed to the risk of higher inflation and general economic uncertainty across the industry and the regions in which the Company operates.

The challenging macroeconomic conditions have impacted consumer confidence, the ability and willingness of clinicians to obtain financing to purchase equipment, and consumer discretionary spending for elective procedures, leading to adverse impacts on the Company's results of operations, particularly in the United States. The Company has taken actions to attempt to mitigate the effects of challenging macroeconomic conditions and may take further actions in the future.

As disclosed in Part I, Item 1A, "Risk Factors," the Company's business is subject to risks related to, among other factors, tariffs and other trade protection measures put in place by the United States and other countries. The U.S. government has implemented or is in the process of implementing various tariffs on the importation of goods from certain countries, a number of which are applicable to the Company's supply chain, operations, and sales, and the tariffs enacted or proposed by the Trump Administration and retaliatory tariffs by other countries could make it significantly more difficult or costly for the Company to import certain products or materials to the United States, or export products or materials from the United States to other countries. Currently, a small portion of the products, materials, and components used in our products are imported from China, and a significant share of the dental equipment that we sell in the United States is manufactured in Europe. Europe is also a major market for our products, including certain consumable products made in the United States, while sales in China represent less than 5% of the Company's global sales on an annual basis. We continue to monitor and evaluate the ongoing and potential impacts of the tariffs and changes in trade policy, whether implemented or proposed, on our supply chain, costs, net sales and profitability. We have implemented and continue to evaluate additional strategies that would mitigate such impacts, including competitive pricing strategies to offset tariffs and evaluating potential sourcing options that work with our vendors and merchants to seek to minimize products sourced from high tariff rate countries, both for existing products and for new product development. The impact that these tariffs and changes in trade policy will ultimately have on our financial results remains uncertain, including the impact on demand for our products in certain markets if prices rise as a consequence of import tariffs. For additional information, see Part I, Item 1A, "Risk Factors".

Geopolitical conflicts are expected to continue to shape market dynamics and pose general threats to financial stability in affected regions, including ongoing tensions from both the Russia-Ukraine conflict and the conflict in the Middle East. Overall, the Company's operations in Russia, Ukraine, and Israel have not been materially impacted by these conflicts.

The Company's operations in Israel consist of two manufacturing facilities for implants products, with one site in northern Israel and one site in southern Israel, both of which remain open and continue to operate normally. For the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, net sales of products produced at these sites comprised approximately 3% of our consolidated net sales and approximately 13% of the net sales of the Orthodontic and Implant Solutions segment. Net assets within Israel totaled $156 million as of December 31, 2025, consisting primarily of investments in subsidiaries and affiliates, acquired technology, property, plant and equipment, cash, and inventory associated with our operations in the country.

paragraphs: DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc. ("Dentsply Sirona" or the "Company") 為全球最大的專業牙科產品與技術多元化製造商，擁有 139 年創新與服務牙科產業的歷史，並以改善全球口腔健康與失禁照護為願景。Dentsply Sirona 開發、製造與行銷完整的解決方案，包括具備雲端軟體支援的高科技牙科設備，以及在泌尿科與腸胃科領域的牙科產品與醫療消耗品，並透過強大的世界級品牌組合進行銷售。Dentsply Sirona 的創新產品提供高品質、有效且連結的解決方案，以提升患者照護並提供更安全、更快的牙科服務。Dentsply Sirona 的全球總部位於美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特市。本公司普通股在美國納斯達克股票市場上市，股票代碼為 XRAY。
Dentsply Sirona 的總部與主要營運據點位於美國（"U.S." 或 "United States"），並透過其海外子公司向約 140 個國家的客戶銷售產品。Dentsply Sirona 在歐洲市場有長期的經營據點，特別是在德國、瑞典、法國、英國（"UK"）、義大利與瑞士。本公司也在亞太地區、中美洲與南美洲、中東地區以及加拿大擁有重要的市場佔有率。
本公司使命為透過創新產品、解決方案與服務，並結合積極的員工團隊，來轉變口腔健康與失禁照護。

專業牙科產業涵蓋牙齒、牙齦與支持骨頭疾病的診斷、治療與預防。本公司提供廣泛的牙科產品組合，這些產品共同提供牙科專業人員在患者照護各階段中，最大化運用科技進展的數位流程。Dentsply Sirona 的主要牙科產品類別為牙科技術與設備產品、牙科植牙、透明牙套與牙科消耗品。此外，本公司製造與銷售用於泌尿科與腸胃科應用的醫療消耗品。作為其牙科技術與設備解決方案的一部分，本公司也提供一個開放的、基於雲端的數位服務平台，DS Core。
這些產品與解決方案由本公司在全球生產，並透過這些產業中最為知名的品牌與商標進行全球銷售。
本公司透過四個應報告分部進行營運：(1) 連線技術解決方案、(2) 基礎牙科解決方案、(3) 正顎與植牙解決方案，以及 (4) Wellspect Healthcare。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司按應報告分部與這些應報告分部的產品類別，將淨銷售額按百分比 disaggregated 如下：
此分部包含本公司牙科技術與設備產品的設計、製造與銷售。這些產品包括設備與儀器以及電腦輔助設計/電腦輔助製造（"CAD/CAM"）產品類別。

Equipment & Instruments 產品類別包含牙科設備產品，例如影像設備、電動牙科手鑽、治療中心及其他用於牙科專業人員與專科醫師的工具。影像設備為本公司數位工作流程方案的關鍵入口點，包含用於 2D 或 3D、全景及內口應用的廣泛診斷影像系統，以及錐形束電腦斷層掃描系統（"CBCT"）。治療中心包含從基礎牙科椅到具整合診斷、衛生及人體工學功能的高階椅側單位，以及用於預防治療及訓練用途的專科中心。此產品組別亦包含其他實驗室設備，例如 amalgamators、混合機及陶瓷爐。
Dental CAD/CAM 技術為專為牙科專業人員設計的產品，用以支援多種數位工作流程，例如牙科修復程序，透過與 DS Core，我們的雲端平台整合。此產品類別包含內口掃描器、3D 列印機、磨牀、某些軟體與服務，以及一種稱為 CEREC 的完整椅側經濟性修復方案，使牙醫師能進行當日或單次造訪的牙科治療。
此應報告分部包含本公司價值增加的根管、修復及預防消耗性產品與小型設備的開發、製造與銷售，這些產品與設備用於牙科專業人員對病患的治療。此分部的產品亦包含專門治療產品，包括用於製造牙科裝置的產品。
Essential Dental Solutions 產品設計為在整合系統中運作，以提供高技術牙科程序的解決方案。根管產品包含電動根管手鑽、檔案、密封劑、沖洗針及其它工具或一次性解決方案，用以支援根管程序。修復產品包含固化光系統、牙科陶瓷、複合材料及其它用於義齒修復的材料，包括冠與貼面。
預防性產品包含小型設備，例如牙科診斷系統與超聲波清潔器與拋光器，以及其它牙科用品，包括牙科麻醉劑、預防性牙膏、牙科密封劑與印模材料。
此應報告分部包含本公司各種數位植牙系統與創新牙科植牙產品、數位假牙及數位正顎治療解決方案的設計、製造與銷售。此分部的產品亦包含應用我們的數位服務與技術，包括由 DS Core，我們的雲端平台所提供的服務與技術。

paragraphs: 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析

以下管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析，係針對 DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc. 及其合併子公司於 2025 年 12 月 31 日會計年度之財務狀況與營運成果之說明。此討論應與本年度 10-K 報告中所附之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。有關 DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc. 2024 年 12 月 31 日會計年度之營運成果與財務狀況之重大影響因素之總結，請參閱我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日會計年度 10-K 報告之 Part II，"Item 7. 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析"（稱為 "2024 年度報告"），該報告已於 2025 年 2 月 27 日向證券交易委員會提交。

DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc.（"Dentsply Sirona" 或 "本公司"）為全球最大的專業牙科產品與技術多元化製造商，擁有 139 年創新與服務牙科產業的歷史，並以改善全球口腔健康與失禁照護為願景。Dentsply Sirona 開發、製造與行銷完整的解決方案，包括具備雲端軟體支援的先進牙科設備，以及在泌尿學與腸胃學領域的牙科產品與醫療消耗品，並擁有強大的世界級品牌組合。Dentsply Sirona 的創新產品提供高品質、有效且連線的解決方案，以提升病人照護，並提供更安全、更快的牙科服務。本公司全球總部位於美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特市。本公司普通股於美國納斯達克股票市場上市，代碼為 XRAY。
• 淨銷售額較前一年減少 3.0%。以固定貨幣計價（非 GAAP 指標，詳見下述 "關鍵績效指標" 頭銜）計算，2025 年 12 月 31 日會計年度之淨銷售額較前一年減少 4.3%。因 2025 年美元貶值約 1.3%，對淨銷售額產生正面影響。
• 網路損失為 598 百萬美元，較前一年之網路損失 910 百萬美元為低，主要係因較前一年減少 650 百萬美元之商譽與無形資產減損費用（前一年為 1,014 百萬美元）。每股稀釋損失為 3.00 美元，較前一年之每股稀釋損失 4.48 美元為低。
• 營運現金流為 235 百萬美元，較前一年之 461 百萬美元為低。
本公司透過四個應報告分部進行業務：(1) 連線科技解決方案、(2) 基本牙科解決方案、(3) 正顎與植牙解決方案，以及 (4) Wellspect Healthcare。
如需進一步瞭解各分部及其包含的產品線，請參閱本 10-K 報告之附註 6，"分部與地理資訊"，於合併財務報表附註中之 "Item 8"。

如本公司於 2026 年 1 月 14 日所公告之 Current Report on Form 8-K 所披露，本公司已與 Patterson Dental Holdings 籤訂新的非獨佔分銷協議，Patterson Dental Holdings 為牙科健康終端市場的主要產品與服務供應商，用以分銷美國市場之牙科設備。此項重組合作關係反映雙方公司對支持牙科專業人員提供先進技術與專業服務的承諾，同時也明確聚焦於未來幾年的成長與創新。
預期 2026 年全球成長將受到多項負面因素影響，主要原因在於全球貿易政策與通貨膨脹相關的不確定性不斷增加。貿易政策的變動、供應鏈限制、能源成本上升、勞動力短缺以及地緣政治緊張等情況，皆已導致產業與本公司營運地區出現更高的通貨膨脹風險與整體經濟不確定性。
困難的總體經濟環境已影響消費者信心、臨牀人員取得設備貸款的意願與能力，以及消費者對選性手術的非必要性支出，導致對本公司營運成果產生不利影響，尤其在美國市場更為顯著。本公司已採取行動試圖緩解困難的總體經濟環境影響，並可能在未來採取進一步行動。

如 Part I, Item 1A, "Risk Factors" 所披露，本公司業務面臨的風險包括，但不限於美國及其他國家所實施的關稅與其他貿易保護措施。美國政府已實施或正在實施針對某些國家進口商品的關稅，其中部分關稅適用於本公司之供應鏈、營運與銷售。特朗普政府所實施或提出的關稅，以及其他國家的報復性關稅，可能使本公司進口某些產品或材料至美國，或出口產品或材料自美國至其他國家變得顯著困難或成本高昂。目前，本公司產品所使用之部分產品、材料與零組件來自中國，而本公司在美國銷售之牙科設備有相當大比例是在歐洲製造。歐洲亦為本公司產品的主要市場，包括某些在美國製造的消耗性產品，而中國市場銷售佔本公司全球銷售的比例則低於 5%。本公司持續監測與評估關稅與貿易政策變動（無論已實施或僅為提案）對本公司供應鏈、成本、淨銷售額與獲利能力的持續與潛在影響。本公司已實施並持續評估其他策略以緩解這些影響，包括競爭性定價策略以抵銷關稅，並評估潛在來源選項，以配合供應商與販商，試圖減少來自高關稅國家的產品來源，包括現有產品與新產品開發。這些關稅與貿易政策變動對本公司財務結果的最終影響仍屬不確定，包括因進口關稅導致價格上升而對某些市場產品需求的影響。如需更多資訊，請參閱 Part I, Item 1A, "Risk Factors"。
地緣政治衝突預期將持續影響市場動態，並對受影響地區的財務穩定構成一般性威脅，包括俄羅斯與烏克蘭衝突以及中東地區衝突所造成的持續緊張情勢。總體而言，本公司在俄羅斯、烏克蘭與以色列的營運未因這些衝突而受到重大影響。

本公司在以色列的營運包含兩座製造廠，用以生產植入式產品，其中一座位於以色列北部，另一座位於以色列南部，兩座廠區皆持續正常運作。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，由這些廠區生產之產品的淨銷售額約佔本公司合併淨銷售額的 3%，約佔正畸與植入解決方案分部淨銷售額的 13%。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，以色列的淨資產為 156 百萬美元，主要為對子公司與關係企業之投資、取得之智慧財產權、廠房與設備、現金及存貨等與本公司在該國營運相關之資產。

headings: 我們高度依賴資訊科技來運作我們的業務與產品組合，任何網路事故都可能影響我們的運作，並對我們的業務與財務結果造成重大影響。
我們的聲譽或品牌受損，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運結果產生負面影響。
我們可能因分佈夥伴及其他因素的競爭優先事項與戰略，而無法執行關鍵戰略計畫，這可能導致財務損失與營運效率低下。
我們的併購、退出業務、資產處置或戰略投資，可能導致財務結果與預期不同，並對我們的業務與營運產生特定風險。
我們可能無法實現戰略計畫預期的效益，包括已執行、已宣佈或潛在未來的重整及其他業務轉型努力。
我們可能無法開發創新產品與解決方案以刺激客戶需求。
我們的持續業務運作可能因一段相當長的時間受到幹擾，導致重大營運成本與財務損失。
我們的智慧財產權可能無法保護我們的產品，且/或我們的產品可能侵權第三方的智慧財產權。
本公司信用評等之變動或總體經濟對信用市場之影響，可能提高本公司之資金成本，並限制融資選項。
本公司之負債可能不利於財務狀況，並導致本公司無法履行債務或契約義務。
本公司之外幣避險及現金管理交易，可能無法有效或僅部分緩衝匯率波動之影響，使本公司面臨未預期之波動。
由於本公司業務為全球性，包括對美國以外市場之暴露程度不斷增加，政治或經濟變動或其他因素，可能損害本公司業務及財務表現。
本公司可能無法取得必要之產品核准及行銷許可。
對使用本公司產品之程序，政府或其他第三方支付者所提供之補償不足，可能導致本公司營業收入下降。
本公司產品可能因實際或被認為之品質、健康或環境問題而面臨挑戰。
本公司業務受廣泛、複雜且不斷變更之
paragraphs: 我們面臨因蓄意攻擊或意外事件所導致的網路事故風險，這類風險可能在日常營運過程中發生。我們使用整合的資訊與科技系統來管理業務並向客戶提供產品與服務。特別是，我們於 2022 年推出的 DS Core，為整合數位牙科工作流程的雲端平台，以及於 2024 年推出的 Primescan 2，為一雲端原生的口內掃描儀，已引入新的潛在網路攻擊弱點。我們資訊與科技系統的廣度與複雜性已增加，且我們預期隨著我們擴展 DS Core 所啟動的服務，以及進一步發展企業資源規劃（"ERP"）系統與產品方案以運用人工智慧（"AI"）與分析（例如 DS Core），這些系統的廣度與複雜性將持續增加。因此，我們將 increasingly 面臨在發展、整合與運作支撐我們產品平台的資訊與科技，以及我們自身內部基礎建設時所固有的風險，包括：
• 資訊系統遭入侵、病毒、網路攻擊、勒索軟體或其他惡意軟體或其它失敗、網路事故或故障；
• 資料中心或硬體、電信設施或其他基礎建設的中斷、損壞或失敗，包括因自然災害所致；
• 在升級或更換軟體、資料庫或零組件的過程中發生失敗；
• 涉及我們業務與客戶的敏感、個人、專屬或智慧財產權資訊遭竊取或未經授權揭露；
• 系統開發與部署過程中的過度成本、過度延誤或其他缺失；
